sessions.note: The service name survives, but Session snapshots no longer contain Conversation views or pending interactions.

workspaces.note: The service name survives, while cross-domain navigation belongs to ui-workspace.

conversation.note: Conversation assembly and input are independent of Session lifecycle snapshots.

slots.note: Slot declarations stay in ui-slots; runtime registration and binding belong to ui-renderer.

removedHostFacade.replacementPolicy: Use the natural business Remote owner through generated api-remotes contributions; there is no replacement facade.
